quantity: And(A) = least number of AND gates of a circuit of AND and OR gates (fan-in at most two, any number of OR gates) that is right on the n*m inputs with exactly one row wire and one column wire on (Lean: Monotone2 + PEqualNP.Represents.Represents; same inputs and points as tables/star_4.json). Only AND gates are counted.
conventions: empty OR = empty set (a wire that does not exist reads false); empty graph: And 0; a union of full rows and columns: And 0; complete graph: And 0 (union of all rows; the star table counts 1 there for the constant gate). An AND gate with fewer than two inputs is a constant or a copy and never needed.
witness_format: "witness": {"L": [...], "R": [...], "out": [...]}: AND gate j = (OR of generators L[j]) AND (OR of generators R[j]); the output is the OR of the generators in "out". Generator index i: 0..n-1 = row (left vertex) i, n..n+m-1 = column (right vertex) i-n, n+m+k = AND gate k. "ckt" is the same circuit expanded into a .ckt (basis ao, ORs of fan-in two); it passes bin/cktcheck --basis ao; "ckt_ands" = number of and lines = And.
symmetry: row permutations, column permutations, and transpose (group order 1152)
rows_convention: bit v of rows[u] = A u v; the class representative is the member with the least value of sum_u rows[u] * 2^(m*u)
exactness: "exact": true means: a circuit with "size" AND gates is stored, and "size"-1 AND gates were refuted by the exhaustive level enumeration of bin/andtab (levels 0..3 complete; docs/andtab.md section 3).
extra_fields: star_mono = exact gate count from tables/star_4.json (null if not exact there; star_mono_lower then); star_mono_ands = AND gates in that table's witness (an upper bound on And); cov0 = least number of all-zero rectangles covering the zeros of the graph; lb_cov = ceil(log2 cov0) <= And; row_types / col_types = number of distinct row / column types that are neither empty nor full (>= And).
